_comment: Renderer auto-selection rules. Only used when no renderer was chosen (global and per-version settings empty). First matching rule wins; within a rule the first available, hardware-compatible renderer wins. Renderer ids are RendererInterface.getRendererId(). Preferences marked 'hypothesis' need device testing; tune this file, not code.

gallium_freedreno.note: Mesa Freedreno targets Qualcomm Adreno only (fact)

gallium_panfrost.note: Mesa Panfrost targets ARM Mali only (fact)

rules.note: hypothesis: Zink with Turnip offers the most complete desktop GL for shader packs on Adreno 6xx+
hypothesis: MobileGlues (GLES 3.2) is the safer shader path on Mali drivers
upstream FCL docs: shaders need VirGL/Zink/MobileGlues; GL4ES-family lacks the required GL features
pre-1.17 uses the legacy fixed-function pipeline that the GL4ES family emulates
keeps today's default (NG-GL4ES) until device data justifies a change
